system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, yeah — I need a little rescue mission for an order.

I’m Noah Patel. I placed an order with three home office items and some hiking gear because I was about to head to my parents’ place in Seattle for a whole remote-work-in-the-woods vibe. Very “laptop by day, trail goblin by weekend.”

But of course, my company has now done the classic plot twist and announced we’re going back to the office soon, so now I probably don’t need the office stuff anymore.

If it’s possible to cancel part of the order, I’d like to cancel the home office items and keep the hiking items. I embarrassingly don’t remember exactly which office items they were, but there were three of them. I also want to know how much I’d get refunded total, and I’d want that refund to go back to my original payment method.

If partial cancellation isn’t possible, then can we just change the shipping address to my NYC place instead? I live in New York, ZIP 10108.

I’ve been a little stressed lately, so I’m trying to avoid accidentally receiving a surprise productivity bundle at the wrong coast.

I can help, but first I need to verify your identity.

Please provide either:
- your email address, or
- your last name + ZIP code

You’ve already given:
- First name: Noah
- Last name: Patel
- ZIP: 10108

If that’s correct, I can use that to look up your account.

Yep, that’s correct — last name Patel, ZIP 10108.

No email for me to give you, unless “anxious man yelling into the void” counts as one.

I found your account and verified you.

I can help with your order, but I need the specific order ID first so I can check what’s possible. Your account has these orders:
- #W1845024
- #W7043598
- #W6111398

Please tell me which order you want me to look at.

Also, one important note:
- I can cancel a pending order, but only the entire order, not part of it.
- If the order is pending, I may be able to modify the shipping address instead.
- To tell you whether either option is available, and what refund would apply, I need to inspect the order details first.

Thanks. Let’s look at order #W1845024.

And ah, got it — so partial cancellation is not a thing. That’s annoying but very on-brand for modern life.

If you can check whether that order is still pending, then:
- if you can change the shipping address, please switch it to my NYC address
- and if the only cancellation option is the whole order, don’t cancel it yet — I mainly want to know what’s possible first

Also, if you can tell me whether this is the order with the office stuff plus hiking items, that would help jog my memory.
